:::{#copis}

## About the grant
As of October 1st, Dr. Sina Thäsler-Kordonouri has joined the lab. After completing her PhD at LMU Munich, Sina will focus on topics like digital communication, journalism studies, and AI at the Digital Media and Methods Lab. She will also be part of the SoWi Methods Hub at the Faculty of Social Sciences. Welcome!
